name: Extension cord
description: Ten metres of orange power cord with a plug at one end and a socket at the other, for running power where a wall outlet cannot reach.
notes: A coil 350 mm across of 8 mm orange cord, its tail wrapped round the bundle, with a two-prong plug and a single socket lying on the front of the coil. One cord is one item. Linking an appliance to a power source has no content field yet. The outdoor cord has its own draft on this model.

name: Outdoor extension cord
description: A heavy yellow outdoor power cord, thicker and longer than a household one, with a plug and a socket at the ends.
notes: Shares the extension_cable model, recoloured plastic-yellow for the common outdoor jacket. A longer cord would draw as a fatter coil; the household coil reads the same at tile size.

name: Tow cable
description: Nine metres of plastic-sheathed steel wire rope with a forged hook on each end, strong enough to drag a vehicle.
notes: A coil 480 mm across of 12 mm black-sheathed wire rope with a crimped galvanised sleeve and a red-painted hook on each end lying on top. One cable is one item. tying reuses the rope quality name; hitching it between two vehicles has no content field yet.

name: Jumper lead
description: A one metre length of insulated copper cable with a spring clamp on each end, for passing power from one battery to another.
notes: Two loose loops 170 mm across of black cable with a red-booted clamp and bare copper jaws on each end. One lead is one item. jump_starting is a new quality name. The heavy-duty lead has its own draft on this model.

name: Heavy jumper lead
description: A thick, heavy-gauge battery lead with large spring clamps, for moving serious current between batteries.
notes: Shares the jumper_cable model with a red cable and black boots so it reads apart from the light lead. A thicker cable would need its own row; at tile size the colour swap is enough.

name: Collapsible bottle
description: A soft plastic water bottle that holds half a litre and folds flat when empty.
notes: Drawn empty and lying flat: a clear blue body 210 mm long and 100 mm wide, 6 mm thick, with shoulders tapering to a screw cap, a label panel and a hanging tab at the base. plastic-clear-blue stays see-through in the game. The box counts the air round the cap and the thin body. The model has no filled state; growing fat when filled would need one.

name: Steel water bottle
description: A brushed stainless steel bottle with a screw cap and carry loop. Holds 750 ml and can sit in a fire to boil water.
notes: A single-walled bottle 73 mm across and 260 mm tall with a rounded shoulder, a black cap and a loop on top. Being single-walled is what lets it boil, so it carries cooking 1, the level for a cup or can.

name: Acetylene burner
description: A brass burner on a steel pan stand, made to run off a welding torch's acetylene line for cooking.
notes: A steel ring base with three uprights and pan supports, a brass bowl and crown burner, and a brass feed tube to a needle valve with a black knob and a hose barb, 170 mm across and 95 mm tall. heating is the quality name used for hotplates. Drawing gas from a welding tank has no content field yet.

name: Butcher's knife roll
description: A canvas roll holding a full set of butcher's knives: cleaver, butcher knife, boning knife, skinner and a honing steel.
notes: Drawn laid open, 400 by 320 mm, so the knives read: a canvas sheet with leather edges and a pocket strip holding the blade tips, black-handled stainless knives, a honing steel and a buckled tie strap. butchering 3 is the kit level, above a single knife's 2; fine cutting folds into cutting. Rolled up it would be about 320 mm long, which the size follows.

name: Can sealer
description: A heavy hand-cranked machine that crimps lids onto tin cans. A lever lifts the can to the seaming head and the crank rolls the seam.
notes: A green-painted cast frame 480 mm tall: a base, a rear column and an arm over the seaming chuck and two rollers, a crank with a wooden knob on top and a lever at the side that raises the can table. It is set on a bench to work, so its quality sits on a workstation. can_sealing is a new quality name. The box counts the air under the arm and round the crank and lever.
